title: #113 – Manolis Kellis: Human Genome and Evolutionary Dynamics
summary: Manolis Kellis is a professor at MIT and head of the MIT Computational Biology Group. He is interested in understanding the human genome from a computational, evolutionary, biological, and other cross-disciplinary perspectives.
